newsitem.title: USA: LL&E sees Q4 production from offshore find.
newsitem.headline: LL&E sees Q4 production from offshore find.

text.p: Louisiana Land and Exploration Co said production is exepcted to begin during the fourth quarter from an exploratory well drilled at West Cameron Block 364 in the Gulf of Mexico.
The company said the well is located 60 miles offshore Louisiana in 80 feet of water.
The #1 well was drilled to 10,479 feet and encountered a total of about 100 feet of pay in four zones. A caisson has been set and completion operations are underway.
This single-well facility is designed to handle 20 million cubic feet of natural gas per day, the expected production rate of the well, LL&E said.
The company owns a 50 percent working interest in the field. The remaining 50 percent is owned by Vastar Resources Inc, the operator of the field.
